question: After conflicts are resolved and real Control UI smoke proof is added, does the UI owner accept this broad export-boundary cleanup as one landing unit?
rationale: The PR carries the protected `maintainer` label and spans many runtime-adjacent UI modules; owner judgment is needed to confirm the intended internal boundaries and acceptable landing scope after the final merge result is visible.

options.title: Review rebased cleanup
options.body: Resolve conflicts, refresh the full diff, add real UI smoke proof, and have the UI owner review the resulting single cleanup PR.

options.title: Split risky seams
options.body: Land mechanical export internalization separately from reconnect, reload-state, build-info, and custom-element registration refactors to reduce review and rollback scope.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Keep the baseline debt temporarily if the rebased branch cannot preserve behavior with reviewable scope and proof.

recommendation.title: Review rebased cleanup
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, refresh the full diff, add real UI smoke proof, and have the UI owner review the resulting single cleanup PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this person to the cleanup issue and every branch commit; no stronger current-main owner trail could be established because repository history commands were unavailable.
